question: Does changing the native Core Image working format from RGBAh to RGBAf remove the moving reference-parity mismatch?
focusedCommand: swift build --build-system native --package-path helpers/mac --configuration debug --product yap-native && YAP_NATIVE=helpers/mac/.build/debug/yap-native node packages/test-harness/editing/transition-delivery.mjs --out <empty-directory>
